title: Especialista de Planejamento de Demanda
description:
Resumo da Posição:

O Planejador de Demanda é responsável por desenvolver, manter e atualizar previsões de demanda para produtos, garantindo um planejamento preciso e colaborativo que suporte as necessidades comerciais, supply chain, compras e produção. O profissional atuará como o elo entre as áreas comerciais, marketing e operações, assegurando que a empresa tenha uma visão clara da demanda futura, minimizando rupturas e excesso de estoque, além de contribuir para a otimização da cadeia de suprimentos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento de demanda, supply chain ou áreas de planejamento e controle (MANDATORIO)
  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de planejamento de demanda e sistemas ERP (ex: Plannera, SAP IBP, etc).
  • Experiência com modelos estatísticos e previsões quantitativas.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e utilização de ferramentas como Excel (avançado), Power BI ou outras plataformas de Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência em participação em processos de S&OP.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com diversas áreas funcionais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alta atenção a detalhes e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico

Diferenciais (Desejável):

  • Experiência em empresas com operações complexas e multi-regionais.

Atividades

  • Desenvolver e atualizar previsões de demanda com base em análises estatísticas de dados históricos, sazonalidade, tendências de mercado e informações de clientes:
  • Obter e organizar dados históricos de vendas, variações sazonais e campanhas de marketing anteriores, garantindo que estejam completos e consistentes para análise.
  • Trabalhar com dados internos (histórico de vendas, promoções passadas) e externos (dados de mercado, tendências econômicas, clima, etc.)
  • Utilizar modelos estatísticos, como séries temporais (ARIMA, média móvel, suavização exponencial) e técnicas de regressão, para gerar previsões de demanda.
  • Avaliar e selecionar o modelo mais adequado para cada tipo de produto ou categoria, dependendo do comportamento da demanda.
  • Identificar padrões sazonais e cíclicos que possam influenciar a demanda, ajustando as previsões para diferentes períodos do ano. Adaptar as previsões conforme mudanças no mercado ou em condições econômicas.
  • Incorporar Tendências de Mercado: Analisar dados de tendências de mercado e comportamento de clientes
  • Utilizar informações qualitativas das equipes de vendas e marketing para ajustar previsões, incluindo aspectos como ciclos de vida de produtos.
  • Participar ativamente do processo de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), revisando e ajustando previsões com base em restrições de capacidade, metas financeiras e necessidades de mercado.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das previsões de demanda (acurácia de forecast) e implementar melhorias contínuas para aumentar a precisão.
  • Acompanhar KPIs relacionados à demanda, como forecast accuracy, nível de serviço, cobertura de estoque e giro de inventário, entre outros;
  • Comunicar os resultados e insights das previsões para stakeholders internos, ajudando na tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de ruptura de estoque e sobrecarga de inventário, recomendando ações corretivas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e softwares especializados de planejamento de demanda para realizar análises detalhadas e cenários “what-if” para otimização.
  • Desenvolver diferentes cenários de previsão para simular mudanças no mercado ou variáveis internas, como variações de preço, alterações no mix de produtos ou lançamentos de novas linhas, e avaliar o impacto dessas alterações na demanda projetada.
  • Manter a integridade e a atualização dos dados nos sistemas de planejamento, garantindo que todas as informações de demanda sejam precisas e atualizadas.
  • Propor e liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua em processos de previsão e planejamento de demanda.

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Estamos desenvolvendo os negócios da no Brasil e precisamos aumentar nossa força de trabalho para atender à demanda do mercado. Essa pessoa irá auxiliar nas tarefas de vendas em regiões não cobertas por distribuidores. Ela será responsável por preparar cotações para os clientes com base nos leads, visitar clientes, desenvolver negócios e realizar follow-up. Também deverá buscar melhorias e desenvolver os processos do departamento para torná-lo mais eficiente e oferecer um melhor atendimento aos clientes. Será responsável por preparar e analisar a região em busca das melhores oportunidades para a Sany, atendendo aos requisitos dos clientes.

  • Ensino superior completo (engenharia, administração de empresas, etc.)

description:
Neo4j is the leader in Graph Database & Analytics, helping organizations uncover hidden patterns and relationships across billions of data connections deeply, easily, and quickly. Customers use Neo4j to gain a deeper understanding of their business and reveal new ways of solving their most pressing problems. Over 84% of Fortune 100 companies use Neo4j, along with a vibrant community of 250,000+ developers, data scientists, and architects across the globe.

At Neo4j, we’re proud to build the technology that powers breakthrough solutions for our customers. These solutions have helped NASA get to Mars two years earlier, broke the Panama Papers for the ICIJ, and are helping Transport for London to cut congestion by 10% and save $750M a year. Some of our other notable customers include Intuit, Lockheed Martin, Novartis, UBS, and Walmart.

Growth was further fueled by enterprise demand for Neo4j’s cloud offering and partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and ecosystem leaders. Learn more at neo4j.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

JOB TITLE: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)

Location : Ideally based in or near São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil OR Miami, FL,. Travel will be required especially if based outside of São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview As a key driver of revenue growth in our LATAM region, particularly in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our ambitious revenue targets. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) who can craft and execute high-impact marketing strategies and demand generation programs that align with regional pipeline and revenue objectives.

Reporting Structure The Senior RMM will be an integral member of our Americas Marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Americas Marketing. This role requires building robust partnerships with the Neo4j LATAM sales team and collaborating effectively with various departments, including corporate marketing, digital, developer relations, communications (PR), and product marketing, to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Development : Formulate and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for the LATAM region, incorporating digital marketing, partnerships, public relations (in collaboration with an agency and the communications team), account-based marketing (ABM), and event initiatives aimed at generating leads, opportunities, and deals.
  • Performance Accountability : Lead the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to meet key performance indicators, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Continuously evaluate and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs to enhance execution, efficiency, and overall results.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work collaboratively across all marketing functions to design and implement effective lead generation programs, encompassing digital initiatives, corporate events, and webinars.
  • Event Coordination : Define and implement LATAM-specific events and demand generation programs, including owned events, roadshows, workshops, and participation in third-party conferences. This includes audience segmentation, registration management, promotion, lead handling, and outcome tracking.
  • Channel Partnership : Cultivate and expand engagement with regional channel partners (GCP and AWS) through joint marketing initiatives.
  • Sales Development Partnership : Work closely with Sales Development teams to gather feedback, ensuring timely and effective follow-up on leads.
  • Strategic Communication : Effectively communicate marketing strategies, value propositions, positioning, and messaging to the LATAM sales team, ensuring they are equipped with the latest, most compelling content for effective sales cycles.
  • PR : Assist in facilitating customer and press participation in local activities, including press releases, case studies, event presentations, and industry awards.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be a key member of the Americas Regional Marketing team. The team is responsible for driving the highest quality lead generation programs that take customers and prospects through their buyers’ journey using all activities in the marketing mix including digital, partner and event programs.

As a Senior Regional Marketer, you will drive opportunities and pipeline growth by developing and executing on a quarterly marketing plan based on approved budgets. You’ll recommend digital programs, specific regional activities and local events, and determine what demand generation content needs will drive business results for the region. This position requires significant cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

  • Languages : Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is required for this role. While not required, proficiency in Spanish is considered a strong plus.
  • 7+ years in Regional Marketing, with a proven track record in developing and executing pipeline-generation programs, digital initiatives, and events. Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) is a plus.
  • 5+ years collaborating on PR and thought leadership strategies for regional growth.
  • Strong demand generation expertise, analytical abilities, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience in event planning, execution, and post-event analysis.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to meet goals.
  • Goal-oriented self-starter with a proactive, independent work style who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead projects from concept to completion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to work at both the tactical and strategic levels, including effective budget management and ROI optimization.
  • Technical Proficiency : Advanced knowledge of Marketo, Tableau and Salesforce is essential.
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph database in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.
  • Neo4j was named as a Visionary in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Database Management Systems among 19 other recognized global DBMS vendors. Neo4j was also ranked as a Strong Performer among 14 top vendors in The Forrester Wave: Vector Databases, Q3 2024.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Gameplay Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other Epic projects. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact Gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent gameplay teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team
  • Working closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets. This will also include mentorship of rigging-focused technical animators
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles. Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver
  • Control Rig experience a plus
  • Python programming is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Buscamos pessoa apaixonada pela área de vendas, com a missão de impulsionar o crescimento da nossa área de Cloud Services .   • Geração de novas oportunidades de negócio: Prospectar ativamente novos clientes, identificar suas necessidades e apresentar soluções personalizadas do Google Cloud que resolvam seus desafios de negócio;
  • Gestão do ciclo de vendas: Conduzir todas as etapas do processo de vendas, desde a qualificação de leads, elaboração de propostas comerciais junto ao time de arquitetura, negociação de contratos e fechamento de vendas, utilizando metodologias ágeis e eficazes;

  • Realizar as atividades e procedimentos administrativos e operacionais do processo de vendas estabelecidos;
  • Atender diretamente clientes, atuando desde a prospecção até o fechamento de oportunidades;
  • Preparar, agendar e participar de reuniões com clientes predominantemente por meio presencial, e também por telefone e videoconferência;
  • Atuar como influenciador no processo de tomada de decisão do cliente, analisando cenários e agindo diplomaticamente nos relacionamentos e negociações;
  • Elaborar e apresentar de propostas comerciais de licenças Google, billing GCP, licenciamento de terceiros, Qi Apps e serviços especializados Qi Network, conforme portfólio oficial da Qi Network;
  • Preparar e apresentar estudos de caso;
  • Análise de relatório de pipeline, forecast e perda oportunidades;
  • Promover relacionamento com clientes, realizando follow-up, convidando para eventos e ações comerciais;
  • Atualizar relatório das atividades desempenhadas;
  • Realizar o assessment do cliente para viabilizar o fechamento da oportunidade;
  • Vivência como vendedor comercial em tecnologia, com foco em vendas de serviços de Cloud Computing;
  • Vivência em negociações complexas e de alto valor;
  • Conhecimento dos serviços e soluções do Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluindo Compute Engine, App Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, AI/ML, entre outros;
  • Entendimento das arquiteturas de nuvem e dos modelos de implantação (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS);
  • Capacidade de apresentar soluções técnicas de forma clara e didática para diferentes públicos (técnicos e executivos);
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas de CRM (Salesforce, Hubspot, etc.) e outras tecnologias de vendas;
  • Diferencial: vivência em vendas de serviços Google Cloud, AWS, e/ou Azure.

A Qi Network é especialista em inovação na nuvem nas áreas de Produtividade, Modernização de Infraestrutura e Inteligência de Dados e é parceira Premier da Google no Brasil. Somos certificados como especialistas em Transformação do Trabalho, além de possuir profissionais certificados em Google Cloud nas áreas de arquitetura de soluções, infraestrutura de TI e projetos de análise de dados. title: Component Leader(d/f/m)
description:
We are seeking an Elevator Architect to join our R&D team and assist us in creating a standard global elevator product architecture, which includes the functional definition of modules and module interfaces.

You will be a member of the Global Product Architecture Team, which comprises system architecture methodology experts who coordinate and drive the creation of deliverables for the Modular Product Architecture Project.

You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders from R&D, PLM, PSM, MFG, and Field/Sales, as well as experts in all product areas, to standardize key module interfaces to minimize rework when module implementation changes.

You will also participate in the Product Architecture Update Process, which establishes the methodology and standard work for updating the architecture and standard interfaces.

This activity is a high priority for our company, as it will enable R&D efficiency and cost reduction for all elevator products.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Platform Development: Lead the development and maintenance of core platform components, including kernel modules, device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware abstraction layers, ensuring seamless integration with hardware and higher-level software layers.
  2. System Image Customization: Lead the creation of Linux-based system images using the Yocto Project, tailoring configurations to meet specific hardware and project requirements.
  3. Platform Tooling and Abstraction Layers: Build and maintain tools, APIs, and abstraction layers that simplify application development. Provide a reliable and efficient platform that enables application teams to focus on delivering innovative solutions.
  4. Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of developers focused on platform development. Cultivate technical growth within the team by sharing expertise in embedded software development. Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability to achieve high-quality deliverables.
  5. Planning and Transparency: Track team progress and ensure alignment with project timelines and deliverables. Maintain clear visibility into development activities, identify risks early, and adjust plans as needed to meet committed deadlines. Report progress and challenges to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  6. Collaboration and Team Work: Work closely with the Technical Leader, Product Owner, other Component Leaders and stakeholders to align platform development with broader project goals. Collaborate with hardware engineers, platform, application and test automation teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across the solution.

Qualifications:

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  2. Experience: 7+ years of experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on low-level programming and Linux-based platforms.
  3. Skills:
    • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems, kernel programming, and hardware-software integration.
    • Experience with the Yocto Project for system image building and customization.
    • Proficiency in developing device drivers, BSPs, and hardware abstraction layers.
    • Familiarity with hardware and networking communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, GSM.
    • Strong experience with troubleshooting of complex problems in diverse environments.
    • Basic knowledge for reading electronic schematics and datasheets.
    • Familiarity with end-to-end testing approaches and test automation, preferably with hardware-in-the-loop testing, to ensure reliable integration and quality of embedded systems.
    • Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  4. Soft Skills:
    • Strong ability to interact and align with stakeholders and technical leaders across the company, ensuring effective communication and shared understanding of project goals.
    • Proven ability to contribute to a collaborative team environment, always working as a team player and actively supporting colleagues and driving collective success.
    • Highly collaborative with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
    • Clear and effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.
  5. Language: Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience with hardware development.
  2. Experience working in a global environment with cross-functional teams.
  3. Background in digital transformation, connectivity solutions, or IoT in the industrial or building automation sector.

description:
Amazon is looking for a Senior Program Manager to drive carbon reduction in our Brazil transportation operations including through adoption of Low Carbon Fuels and Electrification, as part of our Rest of World (ex North America, Europe) Operations Sustainability team. This role is based in Brazil.


You will develop and implement a plan alongside local and global operations leaders and partner teams to deliver strong year-on-year progress toward Amazon's commitments set out in the Climate Pledge. As well as owning this plan for Brazil, you will work closely with sustainability leaders in other countries to leverage scale and best practices.


The ideal candidate has experience working with zero/low-carbon technologies and a proven track record of leading successful sustainability projects, and/or relevant experience in logistics, last mile, fulfilment or Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) operations. Familiarity with the region, low-carbon technologies and delivering change in organizations are an advantage.


Additionally, this candidate has the ability to think strategically, navigate complex and ambiguous challenges, manage large-scale projects across different technologies and stakeholder groups, and collaborate and influence effectively.


Key job responsibilities

  1. Develop and execute plans to drive technology deployment and improvement in operational metrics toward short- and long-term sustainability goals.
  2. Guide operational teams on how to reduce emissions, plan their budgets, and secure resources for decarbonization.
  3. Develop and implement investments in zero/low-carbon fuels and transportation technologies in Brazil.
  4. Engage in public-private partnerships and industry coalitions to unlock innovative solutions. Partner with Public Policy teams to identify key policy opportunities to accelerate zero/low-carbon fuels and transportation technology adoption.
  5. Drive broad engagement among leaders and Amazon colleagues at all levels to influence decision-making and daily behaviors toward sustainability goals.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Working experience of program or project management.
  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements.
  • Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communications skills in English and Portuguese (C1+).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Working experience driving process improvements experience.
  • Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto, a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando e realizando os eventos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;

    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.

Técnico Segurança do Trabalho – RP 16158 Sistema Fiep (Fiep, Sesi, Senai e IEL)

description:

O CIEDS é contrário a qualquer forma de discriminação e está comprometido com a inclusão, a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Se você acha que pode se beneficiar da nossa política de ação afirmativa, por favor informe na sua candidatura.

Missão:
Atuar como ponte entre empreendedores, autônomos e organizações dos territórios atendidos, oferecendo suporte acessível e personalizado para fortalecer a atividade econômica local. Através de um atendimento próximo e humanizado, conectar essas iniciativas a ferramentas, redes de apoio e oportunidades que impulsionem seu desenvolvimento sustentável.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Levantar informações sobre comércios locais, autônomos, empreendedores e organizações nos territórios atendidos.
  • Esclarecer que o atendimento é um suporte gratuito para incentivar a atividade econômica na favela.
  • Organizar e executar atendimentos presenciais ou agendados.
  • Lançamento dos atendimentos no sistema de coleta de dados.
  • Envio do questionário via WhatsApp para avaliação do atendimento.
  • Direcionamento para canais de apoio ou outros serviços quando aplicável.
  • Inserção dos atendidos na rede de empreendimentos do CIEDS.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ser maior de 21 anos.
  • Estar em formação, preferencialmente em cursos técnicos, superiores ou de pós-graduação, nos cursos de Administração, Gestão de Negócios, Engenharia de Produção, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Residir nos territórios de abrangência do projeto: Campo Grande, Complexo da Penha e Nova Iguaçu.
  • Ter boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais, pautadas no respeito, honestidade e cordialidade.
  • Ser proativo e capaz de realizar busca ativa de empreendedores de forma autônoma.
  • Ter interesse por empreendedorismo, inclusão produtiva e cultura das favelas.

Tempo de Experiência:

  • Não há tempo mínimo de experiência exigido, mas experiências prévias na área são um diferencial.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Capacidade de mobilização e articulação em comunidades.
  • Habilidade para comunicação eficaz e criação de redes de relacionamento.
  • Conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e inclusão produtiva.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia como empreendedor ou já ter enfrentado o fechamento de um negócio.
  • Experiência com vendas.
  • Experiência com orientação de negócios.
  • Participação em projetos de formação de lideranças e mobilização social.

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
The Opportunity
"As an AI Pre-Sales Scientist you’ll be responsible for communicating to clients on FICO’s AI/Gen AI and machine learning/analytic methods and latest innovations to drive sales efforts for FICO’s solutions that manage risk, fight financial crime, build profitable customer relationships, and meet regulatory requirements. As an AI/Gen AI and machine learning/analytic domain expert, you will engage customers at mid-level management and technical levels to ensure strong knowledge of FICO’s product differentiation and unique intellectual property (IP). Also, you will support direct sales in the communication of FICO’s differentiation of FICO’s AI/Gen AI capabilities via presentations and product deep-dive sessions. Whenever the opportunity arises, you will gather customer feedback to inform and lead the creation of new IP to guide FICO’s product and business development roadmap." - Analytics VP
What You'll Do

  • You will elevate how we engage with internal and external business on topics related to AI/Gen AI.
  • You will be accountable for driving strong customer engagement and understanding of FICO’s AI/Gen AI product offerings, understanding customer needs and relating those needs to machine learning/analytic methods utilized in FICO’s AI/Gen AI products.
  • You will also bring new requirements back to the product development team for consideration as part of our AI/Gen AI product roadmaps.
  • You will participate in research projects to identify emerging trends and technologies in AI/Gen AI space that can help us develop new products and expand our IP library.
  • You will focus on external communications bringing to our customers move visibility of the AI/Gen AI innovations and process behind the innovations, including speaking engagements, collateral development, presentations, and social medial messaging.
  • You will create proof of concepts, product demonstrations, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and prepare sales package proposals.

What We're Seeking
  • MSc degree in computer science, engineering, physics, statistics, mathematics, operations research or natural science fields with hands-on related experience in data science, including AI/Gen AI and machine learning.
  • Experience analyzing large data sets and applying data-cleaning techniques along with performing statistical analyses leading to the understanding of the structure of data sets.
  • Proven and demonstrable experience with at least three of the following machine learning algorithms: neural networks, logistic regression, non-linear regression, random forests, decision trees, support vector machines, linear/non-linear optimization.
  • Experience working with Java and Python, and strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
  • Experience with AI and Gen AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow or PyTorch).
  • Experience with at least one cloud-based platform (e.g., AWS SageMaker or Azure Machine Learning).
  • Adept at translating business problems into solution statements.
  • Strong communication skills and bilingualism/multilingualism are highly desirable.
  • Open for travel (50% — national and international travel).

Our Offer to You
  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  • Credit Scoring — FICO Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

  • Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.
  • Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.

EBANX is a global fintech founded in 2012 with a mission to be the leading payments partner in rising markets. We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

As a Software Engineering Specialist , you will be part of EBANX's core technical team. Our group owns the entire cross-border and local payment processing platforms.

The payment platform is the flagship product of EBANX. Our team is responsible for its development, expansion, and evolution, alongside balancing the requirements and projects for other vital areas such as Product, Commercial, and Operations.

What you will do:

  • You will be required to promote an engineering culture that cherishes high quality and flexible code to foster a culture of excellence;
  • Actively promote the development of our technical leadership pipeline;
  • Sponsor the development and evolution of internal tools and practices to achieve all above;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience of at least 7 years designing, implementing, and deploying software solutions to production, including at least 2 years of experience as a technical leader;
  • Proven experience of at least 5 years with Object-oriented programming;
  • Vision for software quality, the evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • Ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;
  • Knowledge in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence, and distributed systems;

What would we love to see?

  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS;
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 solid hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - almost no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • Company provided toolset so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Discord, Zoom, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jenkins, DataDog, Rollbar, ElasticSearch, Kibana, SonarQube)
  • Code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out will be heard and we are open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Annual performance evaluations;

EBANX offers:

  • A challenging environment, with opportunities to grow;
  • Casual office and dress code;
  • Spanish, English and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: Semi flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday) and Birthday Day Off
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

This is an opportunity to lead a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions across public clouds and data centers. The role involves working with a broad spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu to virtualization, private cloud, Kubernetes, and advanced open source solutions like MLops platforms and data platforms. As Canonical expands into new industries such as telecom, finance, healthcare, and media, we develop new open source solutions tailored to their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers, comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and engaging in technical presales. They should contribute technically but focus more on shaping team direction, focus, and delivery. We also focus on growing management skills and soft skills in our engineers.

Our goal is to make open source easier, reliable, and secure, aiming to provide 'most software to most companies'. We select engineers globally for brilliance and motivation, and our managers help teams achieve their potential and take pride in their results.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical

The team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical works directly with customers to design private and public cloud solutions tailored to workload needs. Technologies include on-premise solutions like Openstack, MicroCloud, Ceph, and deployable solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL. Managers and team members deploy, test, and hand over solutions, and participate in presales to advise during sales processes.

Job Description

Wood is currently recruiting for an Instrumentation & Controls Instructor with a strong understanding of operations training requirements to be based in Basra, Iraq on a 28 Days on / 28 Days Off Rotation.

Responsibilities

Instructor Duties & Responsibilities:

  1. Prepare training programs and manage presentation materials / equipment.
  2. Perform Gap analysis on the competency level of the company workforce and develop a training program closing the gaps as per the company competency level requirements.
  3. Deliver training efficiently with strong focus on Oil & Gas assets.
  4. Present training material in a professional, interesting, and stimulating manner.
  5. Develop and publish different levels of training programs to satisfy the company needs which include Classroom and OJT activities.
  6. Deliver Individual competency development training with a holistic approach which includes SHE and WMS considerations in accordance with the client and Iraq government regulations as well as industry systems as applicable.
  7. Assess the students’ capabilities and modify program material / presentation as needed to maximize the student’s learning.
  8. Maintain program performance, completion, attendance, evaluation records and perform LMS data input functions as defined by the client Training Management.
  9. Interface and coordinate training activities with the Company and other personnel to effectively achieve program presentations and completion objectives.
  10. Ensure all students engage positively in learning experience.
  11. Assist and encourage students who experience difficulties.
  12. Operate training facilities instructional and presentation equipment.
  13. Ensure all developed training material is presented for archiving by the Document Controller.

Craft Assessment & Responsibilities

  1. Work with Training Supervisor and Discipline Superintendent to establish/review assessment criteria.
  2. Conduct assessments on O&M personnel to establish gaps in craft competencies.
  3. Conduct assessments in a professional, interesting, and stimulating manner.
  4. Ensure all students engage positively in assessment experience.
  5. Assist and encourage students to provide evidence of prior formal training and previous work experience.
  6. Modify assessment process as needed to maximize students’ involvement.
  7. Maintain up to date records of all assessments planned and completed.
  8. Ensure all developed assessment material is presented for archiving by the Document Controller.

Qualifications

Education : University Degree: Any discipline & Accredited Assessor license.

Technical Skills Required

  1. Strong oil & gas upstream operational, technical, or supervisory background.
  2. Knowledgeable of / competent with basic upstream oil & gas operational programs.
  3. Competent / experienced with upstream oil & gas and craft training programs.
  4. Strong training presentation, coordination, evaluation, & planning skills.
  5. Competent computer skills; presentation, spreadsheets, document preparation.
  6. Proven competence with procedure development and presentation software.
  7. Has proven ability to communicate technical information and procedures to students of varying levels.

Personal Skills

  1. A minimum of 10 years in a similar role with 5 years’ experience OJT / Classroom Training.
  2. Minimum of 10 years of experience in Upstream and Downstream businesses.
  3. Preferably holds an accredited Assessor Qualification.
  4. Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  5. Good interpersonal skills, able to work in multi-culture and multi-company environments.
  6. Bi-Lingual (English / Arabic) ability preferred.
  7. Candidates must have a Basra Residency Card.

Langan is seeking an entry-level Civil Engineer to join its collaborative team in Doylestown, PA. This individual will serve a key function in providing assistance with the planning, design, and permitting of civil engineering, land development, and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain experience in site/civil engineering design for mixed-use developments, shopping centers, residential, higher education, federal, and other exciting land development projects.

  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment; and
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday with occasional evenings and weekends.

Langan provides a rich array of programs and benefits to help its employees advance their careers and enhance the quality of their lives. Our comprehensive compensation package includes: full-time employment company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and paid pregnancy disability leave; 401(k)/Roth with company match; paid time off including parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses; and educational reimbursement.

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras, ajudando-os a ter uma vida mais saudável.

description:
Brex: AI-powered Spend Platform

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform that helps companies manage their expenses with integrated corporate cards, banking, global payments, and intuitive software for travel and expenses. Thousands of companies, from startups to enterprises—including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass—use Brex to control spending, reduce costs, and increase efficiency globally.

Working at Brex means pushing your limits, challenging the status quo, and collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture, empowering you with the tools, resources, and support needed to grow your career.

Our mission is to reimagine financial systems to help growing companies realize their full potential. As the financial OS, we develop software and services that disrupt traditional institutions with innovative products and experiences tailored to our customers' ambitions.

Engineering at Brex

The Engineering team encompasses Data, IT, Security, and Software, responsible for creating innovative products and infrastructure for internal and external users. Our autonomous, collaborative teams are eager to learn, teach, and improve continuously. We aim to build robust, scalable systems that enable Brex's rapid growth and help our customers succeed. Engineers take pride in their work, ownership, and accountability, knowing that today’s software forms the foundation for future systems.

What You’ll Do

We seek passionate individuals to build data-driven risk management systems. You will gain exposure to all aspects of financial crime prevention, from developing customer-facing experiences to collaborating with data scientists to integrate models into production. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, as the role involves interfacing with multiple systems across Brex.

You will work on high-impact projects, maintaining data integrity, ensuring compliance, and driving financial outcomes. This role offers specialized knowledge in risk management and contributes to building trusted financial services while safeguarding customers, the platform, and market integrity.

Where You’ll Work

This role is based in our São Paulo office. You must be willing to work in the office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when our São Paulo office opens.

Responsibilities

  1. Ensure high-quality data for decision systems, using risk vendors and internal models to provide actionable insights for risk management and customer experience improvements.
  2. Develop low-latency decision systems for risk assessment during onboarding, payments, authentication, and in-app processes, leveraging machine learning models.
  3. Build in-product tools to enhance decision systems while making risk management unobtrusive.
  4. Create systems for comprehensive customer due diligence, including KYC, sanctions, adverse media, PEP, and AML monitoring.

Minimum Requirements

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Kotlin, Go, Python, or Java. Experience with Kotlin is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of Machine Learning and experience working with ML-integrated systems, supporting model deployment and feature pipelines.
  • Interest in data-driven systems, solving complex problems, and risk management (prior risk experience is not required).
  • Aptitude for building effective, user-centric tools for internal teams.
  • Strong ownership, motivation to protect customers, and high standards.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to work in the São Paulo office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications.
  • Experience with low-latency decisioning systems at scale and deploying models.

Note: Job-seekers should be cautious of malicious actors seeking personal data. Brex recruiters will only contact candidates via LinkedIn or email from the @brex.com domain. Beware of outreach from other sources claiming to be from Brex.

São Paulo-SP, Brazil or Porto Alegre-RS, Brazil

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company , with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN).   • Use your strong understanding of the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem to help the team navigate non-trivial testing scenarios, such as video streaming, Bluetooth, and other peripherals, poor network conditions, etc.

On-Call Support: This role includes periodic on-call duties to support our critical systems. Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge in implementing world-class engineering practices.
  • Deep understanding of client tech stacks and the ability to integrate and improve them over a series of projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and execute large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of the Android development Lifecycle and ecosystem including languages, frameworks, and libraries (Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley).
  • Comfort with IDE’s, version control systems such as Git, and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure, GitHub Actions) and experience setting up deployment pipelines.
  • Experience in frequently using frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, Mockito/Mockk to write automated tests for your code.
  • Proven ability to recognize symptoms of various impediments to psychological safety and provide effective support.

Bonus Points

  • Expertise in choosing and executing deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize client ROI.
  • Deep understanding and empathy for client hesitations around frequent releases, with proven strategies on how to overcome those hurdles.
  • Proven ability to balance helping and teaching with the need to finish things.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a team to identify the level of support each team member needs in implementing different features.

Why Poatek?

  • Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities)
  • Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses,
  • Flexible work hours and autonomy

The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products

We will rely on you for the following:

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.

  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your daily tasks will look like this:

  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.

Join to apply for the Sr. Cloud Application Architect, AWS Professional Services role at Amazon Web Services (AWS) .

Description

The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, covering a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

The ProServe team is seeking a skilled Sr. Cloud Application Architect to join us at AWS. In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Sr. Cloud Application Architect, you will lead customer engagements, architecting and guiding enterprise application modernization and cloud development. You will work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As a trusted advisor, you will guide customers on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, ensuring best practices, performance optimization, and risk management throughout projects.

Key job responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  • Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

About The Team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and continue to innovate — trusted by startups and Global 500 companies alike to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

At AWS, we foster a culture of learning and curiosity. Our employee-led affinity groups promote inclusion and diversity, supported by events and learning experiences like CORE and AmazeCon.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We are committed to professional development through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and career resources to help you grow.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony and offer flexibility to support your personal and professional life.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise solutions, including application modernization using Python, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, or Ruby on AWS
  • Proven technical leadership in complex projects
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, serverless architectures, containerization, and DevOps
  • Effective communication skills in English in technical and business contexts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SOA, ESB, and n-tier architectures
  • Ability to communicate effectively in Spanish in technical and business settings
  • AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer Associate)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Flutter Pleno / Sênior
description:
Tecnologia é o que nos move e faz a empresa crescer de forma acelerada. Ela começa na base de tudo - nas motos, cada uma sai da nossa garagem equipada com um IoT para garantir segurança e suporte 24/7 para os entregadores, e nos ajudar a tomar melhores decisões de negócio.
Todos os nossos sistemas foram desenvolvidos dentro de casa, tanto os softwares utilizados internamente, para gestão da frota, manutenção e atendimento a clientes, quanto nosso app e plataforma de delivery.
Já nascemos uma empresa 100% cloud, com tecnologias e boas práticas do mercado.
Mas, como toda empresa tech, já estamos de olho na nossa próxima mudança e evolução, onde todos nossos sistemas vão para uma nova arquitetura de serviços, dando mais liberdade para as equipes explorarem novas tecnologias e linguagens de programação.
No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Projetar, desenvolver, testar e documentar aplicações móveis com Flutter;
  • Participar ativamente das discussões de escopo junto ao PM e contribuir na priorização das tarefas com foco total na experiência do cliente;
  • Investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados à escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e confiabilidade das aplicações;
  • Colaborar com o time utilizando ferramentas como Jira para gestão de tarefas e GitHub para versionamento de código
O que esperamos de você:
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Dart e no ecossistema Flutter;
  • Domínio em integrações com APIs RESTful;
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e disposição para aprender e ensinar;
  • Proatividade para identificar e propor melhorias constantes;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos arquiteturais e boas práticas em aplicações móveis, especialmente com foco em arquitetura modular, iOS, Android e WEB.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência com GetX para gerenciamento de estado e navegação;
  • Vivência com plataformas móveis nativas (Android/iOS);
  • Conhecimentos em Kotlin e Swift;
  • Familiaridade com funcionalidades core do Android, como localização, câmera, entre outras;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile, como React Native ou Xamarin;
  • Experiência com processos de CI/CD e automações de build e deploy para ambientes de teste e produção;
  • Conhecimento em NestJS e arquitetura BFF (Backend for Frontend).
SOBRE A MOTTU
Nós da Mottu acreditamos no poder de transformar vidas através da mobilidade e da inovação. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de 100.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México. Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors.
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para atingir o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que melhoram vidas. Valorizamos a superação, a igualdade e a união para construir juntos e transformar a forma como pensamos e agimos. Nós somos Mottu.
Nossos princípios inspiram cada passo da nossa trajetória e guiam nossas ações. Acreditamos no medo de ser mediano e, por isso, não nos conformamos com nada menos do que o excepcional: pensar grande e pensar pequeno dá o mesmo trabalho, então damos cada dia 10% a mais do que conseguimos dar no anterior, sempre buscando a grandeza e a escalabilidade. Nosso Foco no Cliente é inegociável, pois nascemos para dar oportunidade a quem nunca teve uma e somos obstinados em ajudá-los a conquistar seus sonhos. Mantemos a Cabeça de Dono, tomando decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade para deixar um legado com paixão e “sangue nos olhos”. Com Mão na Graxa, arregaçamos as mangas e fazemos nós mesmos para entender e melhorar cada processo, respeitando sempre a opinião de quem está na ponta da lança. E atuamos Ombro a Ombro, apoiando-nos mutuamente, cultivando relações genuínas, sinceras e duradouras, com a coragem de falar a verdade — afinal, aqui não há espaço para jogar em primeira pessoa.
Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e deseja fazer parte da nossa missão de revolucionar a mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo para você! Venha somar ao time e construir conosco o futuro da mobilidade na América Latina.

Service and After Sales Manager | CS & CX | Product Manager | Application Engineer | Technical Sales/Industrial Business Professional

Are you passionate about new technology in the food and process industry and do you want to help make a difference to our customers?

Then we have an exciting position as Field Service Engineer in an international environment available.

SANOVO TECHNOLOGY GROUP is undergoing rapid development and facing new exciting tasks. Our business unit is located in Sao Paulo, Brazil and covers all South American countries. As part of our strategy, we are constantly focusing on strengthening our service setup to provide easier access for our customers. You will be responsible for:

The work will mainly be in South America, and you should expect to travel approximately 75% of the time.

You will plan your work and tasks, including ordering spare parts before service visits, managing on-site installation or service jobs, and preparing detailed service reports and documentation after each task.

We have an informal company culture with high employee satisfaction and a flat organizational structure that allows prompt decision-making. You will join the service team in South America, currently located in Colombia, Argentina, and Brazil.

Before working independently, you will undergo internal training to gain specialized knowledge about our machines and equipment. The training will be conducted locally and at our competence centers in Denmark, Netherlands, and Italy.

What do we expect from you?

We offer an exciting position within an international organization with good development and career opportunities.

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
